notes.title: New Patch & New Ranks! (Patch #07)
notes.content:
We’ve fixed several bugs and improved overall stability: there’s still a little way to go, but we’re getting really close to the finish line! 🏁
🏆 New Rank System
The scoring system kicks in from the 3rd round.

Depending on your placement you gain or lose points according to this scale:
+40, +30, +15, +5, -10, -20, -35, -40

Leaving a match results in an extra penalty, which is even harsher if you are the host.

If you haven’t tried it yet, now’s the perfect time! 🎮
Every match helps us improve, and every bug report is a step forward.
Make sure to follow the project to get the next updates! <3

notes.title: New Patch & New Gameplay Mechanics! (Patch #06)
notes.content:
We’ve reimagined the gameplay mechanics to bring you even more thrilling matches full of strategic choices. Here are the main highlights:

8 Rounds of Rising Tension
Each match now unfolds over eight rounds, ensuring a fast pace and twists until the very last turn.

Action Points Instead of Health Points
Farewell to traditional health points: we’re now using Action Points, a precious resource to manage carefully.

Some powers now cost 1 Action Point to activate.

Action Points partially recharge each round, encouraging tactical decisions.

Accumulable Bets System
Want to raise the stakes and surprise your opponent? You can now accumulate Bets to enhance your powers’ effects, adding a new layer of depth and bluff.

Comeback Mechanics
It’s never over until it’s over! Thanks to the new comeback dynamics, a well-timed move can turn the tide of battle, always offering a chance for a comeback.

▶️ Download the patch now and experience these updates firsthand.
💬 Leave us feedback or a review to let us know what you think (every suggestion helps us improve)!

Have fun and… may strategy be with you! <3

notes.content: In this patch I fixed some bugs, and improved the UI and card control system.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE #03
notes.content:
In this patch, I have updated the structure of the game. It is now a free-for-all mode, where the winner is either the last player standing or the first to reach 20 victories. The game is divided into rounds, and between each round, players can choose power-ups to use during the match.

I have added the option to disable bots and to set the lobby to private, at your discretion, once you enter the game. In the next patch, I plan to fix some minor bugs, increase the number of available powers, and introduce new strategies for achieving victory. I will also implement an Elo ranking system.

Currently, the servers are offline, but I intend to bring them back online as soon as possible. I hope you enjoy this update! If you experience any issues, please let me know in the Steam discussions or directly on my profile.

notes.title: NEW PATCH!!!
notes.content:
The new patch is available. Now the game is truly Super Janken and not just alright janken anymore (check out one of the reviews </3). I’ve added new gameplay mechanics: the match is divided into two phases: the pause phase, during which it is not possible to interact with the cards, and the active phase, during which you can drag a card to the center of the screen by holding down the left or right mouse button.
Every round is decided with the classic Rock-Paper-Scissors (R beats S, S beats P, P beats R), and each participant has 7 R cards, 7 P cards, and 7 S cards available for the entire match. If a player uses the same card twice in a row, that card charges (becomes luminous); if you win with a charged card, you gain an extra point. The card resets if the opponent plays the same card (tie) or if you play a different card.
If you form one of these combos (in the exact sequence) you get extra points, but each combo can only be used once per match:
LONG (4 points): R-P-S-R-P-S // P-S-R-P-S-R // S-R-P-S-R-P
MEDIUM (3 points): R-S-R-R // P-R-P-P // S-P-S-S
SHORT (2 points): R-R-P // P-P-S // S-S-R
SPECIAL (1 point): S-P-R // P-R-S // R-S-P
The match ends as soon as a player reaches 10 points. If both reach 10 at the same time, it continues until one takes the lead; if both run out of cards, whoever has won the most rounds wins, and if it’s still a tie, both lose. Have fun and let us know what you think!
Follow the page to stay updated and to watch the Opa project grow. For any issues, write in the Steam discussions.
